areas.name: Design System Library
areas.description: The published React component and token library that is the product of this repository.

areas.name: Tokens
areas.description: The design tokens such as breakpoints and color manifests that underlie the visual system.

areas.name: Foundations
areas.description: The reference pages showing color, type, spacing, and radius primitives behind the components.

areas.name: Atoms
areas.description: The smallest reusable interface pieces like buttons, text, images, and icons.

areas.name: Molecules
areas.description: Small composed components like cards, fields, menus, and section headers built from atoms.

areas.name: Organisms
areas.description: Larger composed building blocks such as slides, decks, charts, and timelines used to assemble full pieces.

areas.name: Charts
areas.description: The chart building blocks such as legends, scales, and data tables used by data visualization organisms.

areas.name: Templates
areas.description: Full page templates, such as the talk template, that arrange components into a finished piece.

areas.name: Runtime
areas.description: The client and server runtime that renders components, hydrates islands, and serves pages.

areas.name: App Shell
areas.description: The top level app entry and setup files that wire the library together for preview and rendering.

areas.name: MCP Server
areas.description: A server that lets an AI agent query the 540 design system while it assembles a piece of content.

areas.name: MCP Tools
areas.description: The individual queries an agent can call, covering components, patterns, templates, tokens, rules, and images.

areas.name: MCP Transports
areas.description: The ways the server can be reached, over HTTP, stdio, or Firebase hosting.

areas.name: MCP Metadata
areas.description: The generated metadata and image catalog describing components, patterns, and tokens for the tools to read.

areas.name: Build and Check Scripts
areas.description: The command line scripts that build, render, and validate the design system and its pieces.

areas.name: Piece Rendering
areas.description: The scripts that render a finished piece from the template and check its structure, spelling, and rules.

areas.name: Validation Checks
areas.description: Scripts that check islands, pieces, primitives, and runtime behavior stay correct as the library changes.

areas.name: Runtime Panel
areas.description: A debugging overlay panel used while checking rendered pieces at runtime.
